definitions: The action of twisting or the state of being twisted, especially of one end of an object relative to the other.
The twisting of a body by the exertion of forces tending to turn it about an axis.
A measure of the extent to which a curve deviates from being planar, or a surface deviates from being flat.
examples: The bridge collapsed due to metal fatigue and torsion.
Engineers calculated the torsion on the drive shaft.
The mathematical concept of torsion is important in differential geometry.
